goal: Prevent depends builds from silently reusing stale local package archives across separate checkouts
Ensure distinct Git worktrees sharing a package source cache do not build from the wrong source trees
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no known blockers or invalidating changes
agreement: Support confirming the change matches the issue and code looks right (ryanofsky)
Open suggestion to store local archives in WORK_PATH rather than hashing paths in SOURCES_PATH (ryanofsky)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it fixes a silent build correctness bug where worktrees reuse mismatched local archives
Prevents depends builds from compiling incorrect content while computing misleadingly valid checksums
